mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_permission ORDER BY parent_id, order_num
SELECT * FROM sys_permission WHERE type = 1 AND status = 1 ORDER BY parent_id, order_num
SELECT p.* FROM sys_permission p JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.parent_id, p.order_num

SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM sys_permission p JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY p.parent_id, p.order_num
SELECT * FROM sys_permission WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY order_num
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_permission (name, code, type, path, parent_id, order_num, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{code}, #{type}, #{path}, #{parentId}, #{orderNum}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
